data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to save images and videos to the photos gallery with permissions.
data.what_it_does: Saves images and videos from local paths or bytes into the device photo gallery or specific albums. It handles permission checking and requests for Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
use_when: You need to save downloaded or generated images and videos to the device gallery.
You want to manage photo library permissions and handle storage errors gracefully.
avoid_when: You only need to pick images from the gallery (use image_picker instead).
You need complex image editing or rendering features.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
Handles both images and videos, including saving into specific albums.
Includes robust error handling and permission management.
weaknesses: Linux support requires an external non-endorsed federated plugin.
Requires manual configuration of platform-specific Info.plist and AndroidManifest files.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding usage descriptions like NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription in iOS/macOS Info.plist and storage permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick images and videos from the gallery or camera rather than saving to them.
